question: Who was recently conferred with the Sangita Kalanidhi award, considered the highest recognition in Carnatic music in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jayanthi Kumaresh​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• Dr. Jayanthi Kumaresh has been awarded the 2026 Sangita Kalanidhi by The Music Academy, Madras, the highest honour in Carnatic music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Jayanthi Kumaresh has become the **first veena exponent in 34 years** to receive the award, coinciding with the Academy's **100th anniversary**.
 
• The awards will be presented during the **100th Annual Conference and Concerts** from **December 15, 2026, to January 1, 2027**.
 
• As per tradition, Dr. Kumaresh will **preside over the academic sessions** and receive the award at the **Sadas ceremony**.
 
• Other awardees announced for **2026**:
 
 
• **Nritya Kalanidhi:** Bharatanatyam exponent **Narendra G.**
 
• **Sangita Kala Acharya:** Vocalist **Sugandha Kalamegham** and mridangam maestro **Trichur C. Narendran**
 
• **Musicologist Award:** **Dr. B. Balasubrahmanyan**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Madras Music Academy__

 __
 
• Founded in 1927 as an offshoot of the All India Congress Session held in Madras.
 
• Organizes annual music and dance festivals and confers awards in Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• Significance of the Award__
 __
 
• Recognized as the “Nobel Prize” of Carnatic music.
 
• Conferred to honor excellence and lifelong contribution to Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• Other Awards by Music Academy__
 
 
• Sangita Kala Acharya, TTK Award, and Musicologist Awards.
 
• Encourages promotion and preservation of Carnatic music traditions.
